title: LinkPreview — Trust, But Verify... Once
objective: The link preview feature correctly checks a URL's host against an allowlist before fetching it. Get it to end up reading an internal service anyway.

verifier.condition: The final response shown to the user comes from a host that was never checked against the allowlist, reached after the initial, correctly-validated request redirected elsewhere.

weakness: The allowlist check is applied only to the URL the user submits; any redirect that request's target returns is followed automatically without re-validating the redirect's destination.
vulnerableEndpoint: POST /preview (url field; validated once, then redirects are followed unchecked)
seededData: A simulated network: an allowlisted host that issues a redirect, and an internal-only service it redirects to.
hints: The allowlist genuinely works — try a non-allowlisted URL directly and confirm it's rejected.
Now try an ALLOWLISTED url that itself points somewhere else. Does the app check where it ends up, or only where it started?
One of the allowlisted hosts in this lab doesn't serve content directly — it redirects. Where does that redirect go?
burpNotes: Try the allowlisted redirecting URL directly in the preview form and see what content comes back — compare it against what the redirecting host itself would show.
